jobs.name: 02_kalimba
jobs.title: 02 · 拇指琴
jobs.role: 双拇指拨片 · 高速连射
jobs.prompt:
Create a polished game weapon concept design board for Project S, a first-person musical fantasy action roguelite. Use the attached image ONLY as the established art-direction reference: retro hand-drawn anime cel shading, clean dark contour lines, 2-3 restrained value bands, ivory, burnished antique gold, midnight navy, warm reddish wood, burgundy fabric, small turquoise resonance glows. Elegant playful concert-instrument craft, readable chunky shapes, restrained baroque flourishes, practical joints and straps. NOT science fiction, no modern firearm receiver, picatinny rail, ammunition bullets, digital screen, photorealism, gritty rust or excessive glowing clutter. This is a new musical instrument weapon, NOT a gun with an instrument ornament glued onto it.
Landscape 3:2 concept sheet. One unique weapon design only. On the left, a large isolated complete three-quarter hero design occupying 70 percent of the sheet, on a warm ivory background with a soft grounding shadow; show all components and generous clear margins. In the lower right, one smaller framed first-person use vignette showing THE SAME exact instrument and human hands in burgundy fingerless gloves, instrument held low in the frame and emitting a small attack toward the open central aim area in a softly suggested theater. No full character, no HUD, no crosshair, no photorealism. A short heading at top, one concise English role subtitle, and tiny numbered arrows for tuning/activation/holding points. Keep the weapon and its playing mechanism immediately identifiable and physically coherent. The main illustration must dominate. Match the established reference linework and materials, not its entire screenshot layout.
 The reference board establishes STYLE ONLY; do not copy its violin, bow, labels or instrument design. Keep the human mouth completely unnecessary: activation must be clearly visible in the hands. Limit text to title and three short labels; prioritize large artwork and an easy-to-read first-person playing inset.
Board heading: 02  KALIMBA | RAPID
Replace the former flute with a compact two-handed KALIMBA / thumb piano. Recognizable shallow rounded-rectangular warm walnut soundbox, central small circular acoustic hole, two orderly rows of silver spring-steel tines with longer tines at the center, a brass mounting bridge, cream tuning blocks and a narrow midnight-blue inset. About the size of a large paperback, not a keyboard or toy game controller. Practical grip recesses on both outer side edges, thin wrist straps, restrained gold ornament and one small burgundy tassel. Two thumbs rapidly and alternately flick the visible free tine ends, sending a fast stream of tiny turquoise musical bolts forward from the resonator's far edge. The other fingers cradle the back without covering the tines. First-person vignette must clearly show BOTH THUMBS contacting the tines, and the player's top-down view of the soundboard at lower center. The aim area above stays completely open. Add two tiny alternating-thumb movement arrows only in the close detail, not on the main weapon. Preserve SMG identity: 50-note reserve, quick agile rapid fire; no new charge mechanic. Retuning by sliding/turning a small brass bridge cam. No flute, mouthpiece, blowing, long barrel, trigger or modern gun silhouette.

Board heading: 06  ACCORDION | CHAIN
Replace the former French horn with a compact combat ACCORDION played only by hand-operated BELLOWS. Two clearly separated solid walnut-and-navy end housings, one short set of ivory piano keys on the right housing, round bass buttons on the left, a broad burgundy pleated bellows bridging the housings, antique brass corner guards and perforated decorative resonator grilles. Padded side hand straps and a carrying harness support its weight; visible mechanical stops limit bellows travel. Approximately torso-width when partly expanded, not a giant organ or a tiny harmonica. Add a compact ivory perforated score-roll cartridge on the left housing to suggest complex musical sequences. First-person vignette: instrument sits LOW across the bottom, left hand gripping strapped bass housing and right fingers pressing the piano keys, both wrists visible, central bellows viewed from above and clearly compressed inward by the two hands. Each deliberate compression releases ONE heavy gold chord orb on a curved forward trajectory, followed by two small echo blooms in the distance. This preserves the slow 14-note multifunction-launcher role and 12-slot chain-build identity, not a rhythm minigame. Include two simple small bellows open/close mechanism thumbnails with directional arrows. Small tuning latch used between attacks. The central aiming area remains unobstructed. No mouthpiece, breathing tube, blowing, trumpet, horn bell, tuba, pipes or gun trigger. The complete main hero view must show both keyboard ends and the connected bellows at the same time.
